fusions.name: Venom Fling
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 5 damage, up to 1.6 times that at the maximum range of 6 tiles, and makes the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Landing Splash
fusions.desc: You spring up to 6 tiles to the target and land with a ring blow that deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Glance Away
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away, with 15% more dodge chance while you do.

fusions.name: Coiled Haunch
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (136% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
